Notes: Live text from Randy's scrape 2026-10-30 16:40-16:47 ET (dialogs_raw). Scientist Drake Rodriguez: SCDK in Jobe Research 4001 (854.5,34.8,958.6; the Arrival Hall Shadowlands door lands in front of him) and SCDR in Nascense Training Ground 4313. First talk (once per character, quest XDGK): the Bracer of Jobe only. The profession heal crystal and the live meds (Health and Nano Recharger x50 / Stim x25) come with the creation kit (StartPackages.json). Live text: intro, Mandatory?!, contract, Carry on, Test of Strength upload. Other tests, the bracer answer, refusal and later greetings were not captured (stand-ins). Base script from Build-NewbieQuests.ps1, patched by ddogs/tools/Build-JobeSL.py.

ask_brink.Text: I will take the final test.

bracer.Text: Tell me more about that bracer.

refuse.Text: Forget about it. I'm not going to participate in any of your tests.

carry_on.Text: Sounds reasonable. Carry on with your testing, Drake.

Text: To measure your strength, we want to see you defeat three creatures.
{delay 1}\nI am uploading the details right now.{givequest XDS0}
{delay 1}\nThey are all, as described in the briefing, located in this area.
{delay 2}\nReturn for evaluation when you have completed your assignment.
{delay 2}{emote}Drake nods his head and lowers his voice.{/emote}
{delay 1}I am sending the specimen on test one. Track its progress. Rodriguez out.

busy_strength.Text: A Deceitful Weaver, a Shining Coiler and a Beit Gras. They are all located in this area. Return for evaluation when you have completed your assignment.

Text: Take this biomarker. Tag a Hungry Predator, a Lurking Chimera and a Pond Dryad. Target each one up close.
{delay 1}The reward is a Protective Shirt of Exploration.
{spawn QBMS 1}
{givequest XDA0}
{delay 1}Good luck. Come back to me when it is done.

busy_agility.Text: Tag a Hungry Predator, a Lurking Chimera and a Pond Dryad.

offer_sense.Text: A Shadowleet is hiding in the grass near the start of the grounds. Get close and target it. On retail it is invisible until you search; here you can see it.

Text: {givequest XDN0}
{delay 1}Good luck. Come back to me when it is done.
These supplies go to Scientist Sarah Willis. An Imp Disruptor guards her crevice.
{delay 1}Assistant Brad Willis is outside. Target him, then target Sarah and leave the supplies. The reward is a Bonfire Kit.
{spawn QSUP 1}
{givequest XDI0}
{delay 1}Good luck. Come back to me when it is done.

busy_mind.Text: Target Brad Willis, then Sarah Willis.

Text: Out at the brink, kill the Heckler of Evolution. It drops six Delicate Metal Devices.
{delay 1}Bring all six back. The other rock piles are Hecklers of Nature. Leave them if you only need the device.
{givequest XDBR}
{delay 1}Good luck. Come back to me when it is done.
{completequest XDBR}
An ancient device. There is a civilization under this place. If you want to go further, find Scientist Donna Red or Scientist Veronica Escobar out in Nascence.

handin_brink.Text: Let's see it, then. Put it in the trade window.{opentrade}

busy_brink.Text: Six Delicate Metal Devices from the Heckler of Evolution.

full.Text: Your hands are full. Make some room in your inventory first.{close}

Text: {emote}Drake pulls out a printed contract and waves it in front of you.{/emote}
{delay 1}Take a look!
{delay 2}\nYou agreed to let us examine the effects of environmental contaminants introduced to both your body and mind through carefully conducted tests, as part of the experiment.
{delay 1}\nWhy, I have never heard of anyone refusing these tests - considering the rewards!

bracer.Text: That bracer records the examination. Wear it while you take the tests. Under level 15 it can also bring you back to me if you are lost.

refuse.Text: Noted. The offer stands when you change your mind.{close}

Text: {givequest XDPR}
Then that test is ready to close. Speak to me again and I will record it.
{completequest XDPR}
{spawn QBRJ 1}
Your mind held. This ring is yours, and a fresh bracer if Celeth-El kept the other one.

nothing.Text: The tests are done. Nascence is through the way you came, when you are ready.{close}

Text: {givequest XDGK}{completequest XDGK}{spawn QBRJ 1}I am Drake Rodriguez and I will be handling your case today. Here, take this standard issue gear. You'll need it for your mandatory examination.
{delay 1}{emote}You notice that Drake is holding a bracer.{/emote}
{delay 1}{emote}Drake nods his head slightly and covertly lowers his voice.{/emote}
{delay 1}We have a healthy specimen here. I will take him through the usual tests before we send him to the brink. Rodriguez out.
{delay 1}You can open your inventory by pressing 'I' or using the inventory icon on your gui.
\nAre you ready?

rewards.Text: \nEvery test you pass is paid for, in credits and in equipment. The bracer will see to it that nothing goes unrecorded.

Text: Excellent. You'll be well compensated for your trouble, of course.
{delay 1}\nLet's begin!
